findings.evidence: GraphTwisted.lean:216-219: "The final `rfl` in each `diagramPerm` lemma below closes the type-level reduction from `Fin (twistedA n q).dynkinType.rank` ... to the displayed `Fin` type"; Index.lean:222-223 documents the same requirement. No such comment accompanies any `change` in TypeA.lean.
findings.fix: Replace by explicit rewrites where available (`diagramPerm_ofTwistedA`/`diagramPerm_ofA` proved at lines 141 and 148, `Equiv.Perm.one_apply`), and where a type-level reduction really is unavoidable add the comment explaining it, as GraphTwisted.lean:216-219 already does for exactly this `Fin (twistedA n q).dynkinType.rank` reduction.
findings.issue: `change SlStd.rootSubgroupPoints rank (SlStd.graphRootPerm rank (.inl i)) _ _ = SlStd.rootSubgroupPoints rank (.inl (graphPermA rank i)) _ _` silently identifies `GraphTwistedIndex.diagramPerm`'s value with `SlStd.graphRootPerm` and `Fin (LieTypeIndex.twistedA rank q).rank` with `Fin rank`, with no comment. Same undocumented defeq at line 218 (`change d.IsTypeA at hA`), 234 (`change Fin rank at i`), 230 (closing `rfl` after `diagramPerm_A`), and 123-124 (two `change`s inside `toGraphTwistedIndex`).

findings.issue: `steinberg_simpleRootSubgroup` re-unfolds definitions (`simp only [steinberg.eq_def]`, `rw [frobenius.eq_def, plainFrobenius.eq_def]`, `simp only [toGraphTwistedIndex, GraphTwistedIndex.diagramPerm_A]`) instead of using the branch lemmas proved immediately above; the `cases hA` at lines 223/232 already normalizes the index to `ofA`/`ofTwistedA` form, so those lemmas apply. As a result `steinberg_ofA`, `steinberg_ofTwistedA`, `diagramPerm_ofA`, `diagramPerm_ofTwistedA`, `toGraphTwistedIndex_ofA`, `toGraphTwistedIndex_ofTwistedA` have no use anywhere.

findings.evidence: Lines 163-182: `plainFrobenius` referenced only at line 175 and 225; `typeAGraphFrobenius` only at line 182 and 236.
findings.fix: Inline `SlStd.frobenius`/`SlStd.twistedFrobenius` directly into `frobenius`/`twistedFrobenius` and drop the two private definitions.
findings.issue: `plainFrobenius` and `typeAGraphFrobenius` are private one-off wrappers, each used exactly once (lines 175, 182), and each adds a `.eq_def` unfolding layer that the main proof must peel (lines 225, 236).

findings.evidence: Line 91: `isTypeA_iff` is proved by `Iff.rfl`; line 81: `abbrev IsTypeA` is reducible, so the match reduces on each constructor without the rewrite.
findings.issue: `instance : DecidablePred IsTypeA := fun d => by cases d <;> rw [isTypeA_iff] <;> infer_instance`: `isTypeA_iff` is `Iff.rfl` and `IsTypeA` is an `abbrev`, so the rewrite step is a no-op that routes a data-valued `Decidable` instance through a `propext` cast.

summary: The single substantive proof (`steinberg_simpleRootSubgroup`) rests on four undocumented `change`/`rfl` defeq steps and bypasses the four branch simp lemmas the same file proves just above, which are consequently dead everywhere in the repo. Same-file precedent (GraphTwisted.lean, SuzukiRee.lean) does the opposite in both respects.
